zm

year of the zabal day 314

the ZAO has a blog

the newsletter now lives at [blog.thezao.com](https://blog.thezao.com). every edition we have written on paragraph, all 406 posts, reads there now

old paragraph links still work. they send you straight to the same edition on the blog, so nothing we shared before breaks

the emails do not change. the newsletter still comes to your inbox from paragraph, and you still subscribe on paragraph

paragraph shipped a setting called your own website. we write on paragraph and you read on our site. we built ours in the open, it pulls each edition from the paragraph api: [github.com/bettercallzaal/zaoonparagraph](https://github.com/bettercallzaal/zaoonparagraph)

fractal session 2 is today at noon eastern (12 PM ET) with iman. it is free and open to anyone. we go around and each of us shares what we did for the ZAO this week, then the group ranks it together and the ranking earns Respect: [luma.com/lfdnyq7x](https://luma.com/lfdnyq7x)

Today's edition: [Year of the ZABAL - Day 314]({edition})

- BetterCallZaal on behalf of the ZABAL Team
